# GLM-5.2 quickstart

On Together AI, GLM-5.2 runs in FP4 with a 512K-token context window and up to 128K output tokens.

The model ID is `zai-org/GLM-5.2`. Pricing is $1.40 per 1M input tokens.

| Tip | Rationale |
| --- | --- |
| Set generous max tokens | GLM-5.2 supports up to 128K output tokens. Raise `max_tokens` for deep reasoning. |
